title: Unveiling the single-solvent vacuum-flash process for high-efficiency perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05421D, Paper
Huanyu Zhang, Yige Peng, Yurou Zhang, Yi Ji, Zewu Feng, Hailong Huang, Yanbo Wang, Yansen Guo, Chenghao Ge, Xin Li, Xueqi Wu, Yitong Liu, Chaopeng Huang, Jingsong Sun, Xiao-Hong Zhang, Jun Peng
A single-solvent vacuum-flash process enables precise crystallization control, resulting in perovskite solar cells with a champion efficiency of 26.93% (certified at 26.78%).
